LESSON: CIVIC ENGAGEMENT IN GOVERNANCE • SOCIAL JUSTICE • INTEGRITY • PEACE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Developments and Governance
Topic 5.2: Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace, part of Political Developments and Governance in Grade 9 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How does civic engagement promote good governance in the country? 2. How can we participate in democratic processes in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
